privacyModal.title: Privacy
privacyModal.body: Your profile details (bio, skills, contact links) are only visible to you and members of your workspace. Your password is never stored in plain text — it's hashed before it touches the database. You can update or remove any of your profile information at any time from Edit Profile.

helpModal.title: Help
helpModal.tip1: Use Edit Profile to update your role, bio, skills, and links.
helpModal.tip2: Use Change Password to update your login password.
helpModal.tip3: Toggle Theme to switch between light and dark mode.
